title: Q2 – Distance Metrics
summary: Compare L2, Cosine, and Inner Product distances.
description: In the Vector Vault, 'similarity' isn't just one number. Depending on the math you use, the vault might suggest different answers. Learn to choose the right ruler for the job.
objective_text: Calculate the Cosine distance between fragments and a target vector.

verification.query: SELECT fragment_id, content, embedding <=> '[0.5, 0.5, 0.5]'::vector as distance FROM historical_fragments ORDER BY distance LIMIT 1;
